name: Amami Iyo
source:
"If you don't mind, next time, let's practice together...... No, coaching, could you?"

A third-year student in the Knight Training Department, possessing an unparalleled strength. For two consecutive years, she is chosen as the "Best Knight: Brillante," and is admired by the maidens attending Ginran Academy. She rarely shows emotion in her expressions, words, or actions, but on the inside, she is full of emotions and overflows with compassion.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/character_iyo.html]official website[/url]]
